role: Inserts a pointer into the world interface array's pointer-to-index map at world+0x198 and stores the encoded engine back pointer at subsystem+0x008 (mov [rdx+8], rax at 0x141c56fd1) using xor 0xd6c0ac78d0e44481 then add 0x9dd46acd84d192e2

name: EncodeAddressB
role: In-place 64-bit address codec on the qword at rcx: sub 0x574da7a34c106b16 then ror 3; the inverse is not a separate function in the image (0x1405838d0 lies inside WorldCtor 0x1405838c0), it is derived by Codec::inverse in crates/ow-engine/src/codec.rs

name: EncodeSeed38
role: In-place 64-bit codec on the qword at rcx: sub 0x274e2f82e6194a03 then xor 0x45ef9e20123f172f; WorldBaseCtor 0x141c507c0 calls it at 0x141c50839 on the stack seed 0x627dce6e1d5603a4 and xors the result with 0xd674a580a443b55e for world+0x38; Ghidra had no function at this address, created from the direct call site in this pass

name: EncodeSeedB0
role: In-place 64-bit codec on the qword at rcx: xor 0xd6a9bd8714cc2178 then sub 0x416ff37b1ad4aa2f; WorldBaseCtor 0x141c507c0 calls it at 0x141c508a7 with the stack seed cleared to 0, and the result feeds world+0xb0 at 0x141c508d1; Ghidra had no function at this address, created from the direct call site in this pass

name: Sub460ObjectCtor
role: Fills a 0x1b8-byte object with four copies of a six-dword descriptor (0x1442a31d0..0x1442a31dc plus 0x143870e48) tagged 1..4, and returns its own argument; WorldCtor builds it, encodes its address into world+0x460 and drops the pointer

name: SubsystemStubCtor
role: 28-byte base constructor shared by 31 of the 65 engine subsystem slots: stores vtable 0x142f7d778 at [rcx] and the cookie 0x7495174655b5d763 at [rcx+8], returns rcx; every caller overwrites [obj] with its own vtable, so 0x142f7d778 never survives a construction. Ghidra had no function at this address; created from the subsystem census

name: DecodeEnginePtr220
role: In-place 64-bit codec on the qword at rcx: ror 0xf, xor 0x5a1b63795b8475ea, sub 0x4998612e34f258d3, ror 0x1e; ConstructEngineSubsystems 0x140554220 calls it at 0x140555325 on the qword taken from [world+0x330]+0x60 (null-checked at 0x140555310, then +0x60), applies the same inline chain WorldCtor uses for that field (xor 0x6e, add 0x6c5df24a0815916e, xor 0x3c1986ede8c2b44a, ror 0x10, xor 0xc2300451bcb9e837, add 0x5c04429ca265e813) and stores into world+0x220 at 0x140555372, so slot 0x220 is a decoded pointer rather than an allocation. Ghidra had no function at this address; created from that call site

name: SceneComponentApplyInstanceData
role: The placed scene component's vtable+0x20 slot (vtable 0x1433632e0 slot 4): reads the component's instance data through the accessor at vtable+0x10 with id 1, copies three quads from *(result+0x10) into the component at +0x160 (position), +0x150 (scale) and +0x140 (quaternion), then calls SceneComponentSetLocalTransform 0x142000620 with them; a non-zero byte at instance data +0x30 sets bit 0x800 at component+0x248 and notifies component+0x258. This is the writer the collision builder's +0xd0/+0xf0 transform comes from

name: SceneComponentSetLocalTransform
role: Takes a scene component and three quads (quaternion, position, scale). With component+0x298 (the parent) null it accepts each quad only when it differs from the current value - the quaternion when q.q_new < 0.9999999, the position and scale when the squared distance exceeds 1e-8 - builds the 3x3 rotation at +0x60/+0x70/+0x80 from the quaternion, and writes +0xd0 the quaternion, +0xe0 the scale and +0xf0 the position, then notifies children. With a parent it hands over to 0x141ffab90, which composes +0xd0/+0xf0 with +0x298. These are exactly the fields the placed-model collision builder reads

name: ModelChunkSize
role: The model asset's sizing pass: per-tag version gate (MDLC 0x165, MRNM 0x1f, mskl 0x20, LCOM 0x14, MESD 2, HTLC 0x18, MSTU 2), returns 7/6 on a mismatch and the chunk's runtime size

name: ModelChunkLoad
role: The model asset's load pass in chunk order MDLC, MRNM, mskl, LCOM, MESD, HTLC, MSTU, each behind the same version gate; builds the model object at param_1[0xd]

name: MrnmFixup
role: The MRNM in-place offset->pointer fixup: header +0x00/+0x08/+0x10, per vertex buffer +0x10 and (only when flags bit 0x10 is clear) +0x50/+0x58, per index buffer +0x08. Verified as fn/MrnmFixup

name: MrnmRuntimeSize
role: The MRNM runtime-block size: submeshes*0xa0 + 0xc0 + vertex_buffers*0xf8 + index_buffers*0x18, 32-bit. Verified as fn/MrnmRuntimeSize

name: LoadMstuChunk
role: The MSTU chunk load: a zero u32 at +8 stores a null STU, else the STU v2 loader gets the pointer at +0 and the u32 length at +8

name: LoadStuBlob
role: The STU v2 blob loader: CRC64 over the 36-byte header, the type-hash bags and the instance layout

name: BuildModelRuntimeRecord
role: Writes one runtime mesh record (0xe8 teaser, 0x1c element blocks, the a8/b0/b8 arrays, the 0x50 tail); each element is {u8 semantic,u8 index,u8 format,u8 stream,u32 offset<<12|stride<<22}

name: ValidateBrowserCallbackTable
role: Checks a browser callback config against the client's own table: onConnected and onDisconnect required, the optional names accepted, the deprecated ones allowed, every name logged by itself

name: RouteBrowserMessage
role: Parses the browser JSON envelope, requires the integer 'type' field, and dispatches service codes 0x00..0x1a (host to browser) or client codes 0x1b..0x31 (browser to host), each handler reading its own named fields

name: CallJavascriptCallbackMessage
role: Service type 0x0c: reads callback_id and args and calls the page function by id

name: CreateBrowserFromMessage
role: Service type 0x00: builds the browser from the page config (start_url, cache_path, user agent, storage/plugin/console switches, background colour, acceleration, process rate)

name: DecodeJavascriptConsoleMessage
role: Client type 0x2f: decodes source, line, message and method and fires the console-message callback

name: RegisterJavascriptVariableMessage
role: Service type 0x0b: reads scope and value and registers a javascript variable in the page

name: RegisterAvailableHeroesBase
role: Registers the available-heroes restriction component (STU_5427ADC1, type hash 0x5427ADC1, size 0x58)

name: RegisterAvailableHeroesAll
role: Registers the empty available-heroes component (STU_D1DC7C55: no restriction, every hero; size 0x58)

name: RegisterAvailableHeroesWhitelist
role: Registers the available-heroes whitelist component (STU_3C14F504: m_heroes at +0x58; size 0x68)

name: RegisterAvailableHeroesWhitelistAlt
role: Registers the second available-heroes whitelist component (STU_C45DE560: m_heroes at +0x58, the class every mode team uses; size 0x68)

name: MoverAccumulateWorldVector
role: Adds a world-space vector into the local movement vector body+0x1150: rotated by the state rows unless body+0x10d0 bit 24, then four ADDS lanes

name: MoverGravityVector
role: The world gravity vector: (gate * body[0x610]) along body[0xc0..0xcc], the gate read from 0x14202fb00 (constant -10.0 at 0x1431161f8, or 0.0)

name: MoverAirDrag
role: The airborne terminal drag: delta = drag_dt * -abs(gate*body[0x610]/terminal^2 * up_lane) * (up_lane * axis), terminal from body[0x614]/body[0x618] by the sign of the up lane, clamped so it cannot reverse the vector

name: MoverGravityStage
role: The gravity arm: accumulate dt*gravity into body+0x1500..0x150c and add it into body+0x1150 through the state rows; the on-ground arm is a surface drag on body[0x61c]/body[0x620]

name: MoverApplyForces
role: Per-tick force stage: air drag, the on-ground move, three vector stages, then gravity (airborne) or the surface drag (on ground)

name: ScaleFloatRunToQ12
role: Scales a run of f32 to Q12 integers (value*4096, truncated, saturating at +-i32::MAX) by integer bit manipulation; verified as fn/FloatToQ12
prototype: void ScaleFloatRunToQ12(int32_t *dst, const float *src, uint32_t count)
